source: dated Vatican News pages 2021-03-11..2026-12-15 (data/vatican-archive-captures.json), grouped by tools/archive/analyze.py with data/lectionary-exceptions.json

key_rules.temporal: temporal:<day>, with :YEAR_A/B/C for Sundays and for the four conditional weekdays
key_rules.observance: observance:<id>, with :YEAR_A/B/C only where the Gospel varies
key_rules.weekday: a memorial marked weekday:true, and any memorial not listed, reads the weekday entry

observance:mary_mother_of_the_church.decision: Reviewed 2026 date (individual review). Four pages print Ga 19,25-27 and two print the weekday. Open: pages and review differ on the last verse.

observance:nativity_of_the_blessed_virgi.decision: First-listed full option (owner policy): four pages print the full form. The 2026 page and reviewed date use the short form Mt 1,18-23. Open for the owner.

observance:nativity_of_the_lord.decision: Daytime Mass (owner policy). Pages printed the dawn Mass (Lc 2,15-20) in 2021, 2022 and 2025 and the day Mass in 2023 and 2024.

observance:our_lady_of_the_rosary.decision: Proper Gospel on five of six pages and the reviewed 2026 date; the 2021 page printed the weekday.

observance:presentation_of_the_lord.decision: First-listed full option (owner policy): three pages print the full form. The 2026 page and reviewed date use the short form Lc 2,22-32. Open for the owner.

observance:timothy_of_ephesus_and_titus_.decision: Proper Gospel: 2024 and 2026 pages and the reviewed 2026 date (two Vietnamese calendars). 2022 and 2023 pages printed the weekday.

temporal:christmas_time_january_2.via: memorial days that printed the weekday

temporal:easter_time_4_monday.rule: Year A reads Ga 10,1-10 on the Sunday before.

temporal:easter_time_4_monday:YEAR_A.rule: Year A reads Ga 10,1-10 on the Sunday before.

temporal:lent_5_monday.rule: Year C reads Ga 8,1-11 on the Sunday before.

temporal:lent_5_monday:YEAR_C.rule: Year C reads Ga 8,1-11 on the Sunday before.

temporal:ordinary_time_18_monday.rule: Year A reads Mt 14,13-21 on the Sunday before. Applies only when Sunday XVIII is actually celebrated (not in 2023, when August 6 was that Sunday).

temporal:ordinary_time_18_monday:YEAR_A.rule: Year A reads Mt 14,13-21 on the Sunday before. Applies only when Sunday XVIII is actually celebrated (not in 2023, when August 6 was that Sunday).

temporal:ordinary_time_18_sunday:YEAR_A.decision: Reviewed 2026 date (two calendars); the 2026 page prints no reference and 2023 was displaced by the Transfiguration.

temporal:ordinary_time_18_tuesday.rule: Follows the Monday rule in Year A.

temporal:ordinary_time_18_tuesday:YEAR_A.rule: Follows the Monday rule in Year A.

temporal:ordinary_time_3_wednesday.via: memorial days that printed the weekday

temporal:ordinary_time_6_sunday:YEAR_A.decision: Full form: 2023 page and reviewed 2026 date; the 2026 page prints the short form.

temporal:ordinary_time_9_monday.via: memorial days that printed the weekday
